tasks.title: Record activity and the destination

tasks.title: Add the workspace AI schema and resolver
tasks.description: Extend Workspace.ai with provider, baseURL, model, apiKeyEncrypted (select:false), keyHint, configuredAt/By and lastTestedAt/Status/Code. Add workspaceConfig.ts to validate the stored fields, decrypt with secretBox(context=String(workspaceId)), apply only the installation limits, and return available/provider/model/baseURL/apiKey/keySet/keyHint/problem. Split config.ts into limits and remove the AI_*/DASHSCOPE_* provider fallback. Missing provider is AI_NOT_CONFIGURED; an unreadable ciphertext is KEY_UNREADABLE. No migration and no key is copied.

tasks.title: Add the HTTPS URL guard and pinned provider fetch
tasks.description: Add urlGuard.ts: accept only HTTPS, reject credentials/query/fragment, parse host/port, and reject loopback/private/link-local/multicast/reserved/cloud-metadata IPv4, IPv6 and mapped addresses after resolving every DNS answer. Add pinnedFetch.ts using node:https with a lookup pinned to the validated address and the original TLS servername, no redirects, AbortSignal/timeouts and a response-size cap. Add testAiConnection(config) in provider.ts with a minimal content-free chat request and safe result codes.

tasks.title: Add the workspace provider settings API
tasks.description: GET /ai resolves Workspace.ai and returns availability/provider/model/problem; only settings:manage receives config {keySet, keyHint, baseURL, configuredAt, configuredBy, lastTestedAt, lastTestStatus, lastTestCode}. Add PUT /ai/provider (save/replace), DELETE /ai/provider (atomic clear + enabled/autoReview false) and POST /ai/provider/test (saved or transient, 5/min per workspace+user). Validate provider/model/key length/custom URL; require a key on first save or provider change, blank keeps the existing key; encrypt with secretBox(workspaceId), store hint/configuredBy/At, clear last-test metadata on replacement. Record ai.settings_updated with action/provider/model/key set/replaced/cleared and no endpoint/key. Enforce enabled only when available and autoReview only when enabled, and set both false on a first save so a legacy opt-in cannot silently resume. Never return or log the key.

tasks.title: Wire AI code review to the workspace configuration
tasks.description: queueReview accepts the workspace ai subdocument, resolves the config and returns AI_NOT_CONFIGURED before any provider request, uses the workspace daily limit and stores config.model. runReview selects +ai.apiKeyEncrypted, re-resolves, checks enabled/available, and passes config to reviewWithModel. queueAutoReview uses the same path; the GitHub webhook selects +ai.apiKeyEncrypted and passes workspace.ai and the workspace id. In-flight reviews keep the stored model; removal makes the next request AI_NOT_CONFIGURED.

tasks.title: Wire document plans and the settings view to the same configuration
tasks.description: assertPlanFeatureOn/assertCanQueuePlan resolve the workspace config; createQueuedPlan stores its model; runPlan selects +ai.apiKeyEncrypted, re-resolves, checks enabled/available and passes config to generateJson. aiPlanController loads the key with the flags and passes workspace id/settings. settingsView uses the same resolver for availability/provider/model. No env fallback, no record rewrite, existing AiPlan/AiReview data stays readable.
